control_failures.control_label: guarding, clearance and misfire handling for a blast
receipt, magazining and reconciliation of explosives

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: fire on MAG-9601 during transfer operations

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured.

defences.finding: Control BLAST_GUARDING_AND_CLEARANCE: the guarding, clearance and misfire handling for a blast had been bypassed, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control EXPLOSIVES_RECONCILIATION: the receipt, magazining and reconciliation of explosives was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the guarding, clearance and misfire handling for a blast on MAG-9601 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in storing and transporting explosives, specifically receiving, magazining and reconciling explosives. MAG-9601 (explosives magazines) is in service for explosives and detonator storage. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the guarding, clearance and misfire handling for a blast had been bypassed. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 26 November 2023 an incident occurred on MAG-9601 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during transfer operations, releasing chemical energy held as hydrocarbon.
